fields.name: annotations
fields.description: Include Kubernetes pod resource annotations in the extra metadata.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_endpoint
fields.description: Endpoint path for pod-to-service name association.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host
fields.description: Host to connect with when performing pod-to-service name association.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host_client_cert_file
fields.description: Client certificate path for enabling mTLS on calls to the agent server.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host_client_key_file
fields.description: Client certificate key path for enabling mTLS on calls to the agent server.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host_server_ca_file
fields.description: TLS CA certificate path for communication with the agent server.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host_tls_debug
fields.description: TLS debug level for agent server connection: 0 (no debug), 1 (error), 2 (state change), 3 (info), 4 (verbose).

fields.name: aws_pod_association_host_tls_verify
fields.description: Enable or disable verification of TLS peer certificate for agent server connection.

fields.name: aws_pod_association_port
fields.description: Port to connect with for pod-to-service name association.

fields.name: aws_pod_service_map_refresh_interval
fields.description: Refresh interval in seconds for the pod-to-service map.

fields.name: aws_pod_service_map_ttl
fields.description: Time-To-Live (TTL) for pod-to-service map cache entries.

fields.name: aws_pod_service_preload_cache_dir
fields.description: Directory containing pod-to-service map files for pre-loading cache.

fields.name: aws_use_pod_association
fields.description: Enable custom endpoint to get pod-to-service name mapping.

fields.name: buffer_size
fields.description: Set the buffer size for HTTP client when reading responses from Kubernetes API server.

fields.name: cache_use_docker_id
fields.description: When enabled, metadata will be fetched from Kubernetes when docker_id is changed.

fields.name: dns_retries
fields.description: Number of DNS lookup retries until the network starts working.

fields.name: dns_wait_time
fields.description: DNS lookup interval between network status checks.

fields.name: dummy_meta
fields.description: If set, use dummy-meta data (for test/dev purposes).

fields.name: k8s-logging.exclude
fields.description: Allow Kubernetes pods to exclude their logs from the log processor.

fields.name: k8s-logging.parser
fields.description: Allow Kubernetes pods to suggest a pre-defined parser.

fields.name: keep_log
fields.description: When keep_log is disabled and merge_log enabled, the log field is removed from the incoming message once it has been successfully merged.

fields.name: kube_ca_file
fields.description: CA certificate file

fields.name: kube_ca_path
fields.description: Absolute path to scan for certificate files

fields.name: kube_meta_cache_ttl
fields.description: Configurable time-to-live for Kubernetes cached pod metadata.

fields.name: kube_meta_namespace_cache_ttl
fields.description: Configurable time-to-live for Kubernetes cached namespace metadata.

fields.name: kube_meta_preload_cache_dir
fields.description: If set, Kubernetes metadata can be cached or pre-loaded from files in JSON format in this directory, named namespace-pod.meta.

fields.name: kube_tag_prefix
fields.description: When the source records come from the tail input plugin, this option specifies the prefix used in tail configuration.

fields.name: kube_token_command
fields.description: Command to get Kubernetes authorization token.

fields.name: kube_token_file
fields.description: Token file

fields.name: kube_token_ttl
fields.description: Configurable time-to-live for the Kubernetes token.

fields.name: kube_url
fields.description: API Server endpoint

fields.name: kubelet_host
fields.description: Kubelet host to use for HTTP requests.

fields.name: kubelet_port
fields.description: Kubelet port to use for HTTP requests.

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Include Kubernetes pod resource labels in the extra metadata.

fields.name: merge_log
fields.description: When enabled, check if the log field content is a JSON string map.

fields.name: merge_log_key
fields.description: When merge_log is enabled, the filter assumes the log field from the incoming message is a JSON string message and attempts to create a structured representation of it at the same level of the log field in the map.

fields.name: merge_log_trim
fields.description: When merge_log is enabled, trim (remove possible \n or \r\) field values.

fields.name: merge_parser
fields.description: Optional parser name to specify how to parse the data contained in the log key.

fields.name: namespace_annotations
fields.description: Include Kubernetes namespace resource annotations in the extra metadata.

fields.name: namespace_labels
fields.description: Include Kubernetes namespace resource labels in the extra metadata.

fields.name: namespace_metadata_only
fields.description: Include Kubernetes namespace metadata and no pod metadata.

fields.name: owner_references
fields.description: Include Kubernetes owner references in the extra metadata.

fields.name: regex_parser
fields.description: Set an alternative Parser to process record tags and extract pod_name, namespace_name, container_name, and docker_id.

fields.name: set_platform
fields.description: Manually set the Kubernetes platform type.

fields.name: tls.debug
fields.description: Debug level between 0 (no information) and 4 (all details).

fields.name: tls.verify
fields.description: When enabled, turns on certificate validation when connecting to the Kubernetes API server.

fields.name: tls.verify_hostname
fields.description: When enabled, turns on hostname validation for certificates.

fields.name: tls.vhost
fields.description: Set an optional TLS virtual host for the Kubernetes API server connection.

fields.name: use_journal
fields.description: When enabled, the filter reads logs in Journald format.

fields.name: use_kubelet
fields.description: Optional feature flag to get metadata information from Kubelet instead of calling Kube Server API to enhance the log.

fields.name: use_pod_association
fields.description: Deprecated alias for aws_use_pod_association.

fields.name: use_tag_for_meta
fields.description: When enabled, Kubernetes metadata (for example, pod_name, container_name, and namespace_name) will be extracted from the tag itself.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
